propositions: Core outbound_links.py currently imports vendor-specific _RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK from adapters.jira and performs link diffing in Jira shape, violating ADR 0035 and Epic bbf1 AC3 requirements for zero adapters.jira imports in core

Link translation (vendor→canonical via map_remote_links; canonical→vendor via link_payload_for_relation) must move onto the SupportsLinks capability at the adapter boundary, with core comparing only canonical relation vocabulary

map_remote_links must absorb today's _existing_jira_links dedup logic and return canonical tuples (relation, remote_key, opaque_vendor_type) where unknown remote types carry relation=None to preserve today's ignore-and-never-remove semantics
link_payload_for_relation must replace the inline _RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK.get(relation) call at outbound_links.py:105, emitting (vendor_type, swap) for ADD/REMOVE payload construction

ADD dedup must remain direction-agnostic, matching local deps against canonical entries on (opaque_vendor_type, remote_key) regardless of inbound/outbound side, while REMOVE matching is relation-specific via the managed-ref gate
outbound_differ.py must pass the configured backend's SupportsLinks capability as a new 4th argument to _diff_links for capability access without growing adapters.jira imports
